ei.title: Best Soccer Leagues in the World

fullPassage:
Best Soccer Leagues in the World

English Premier League - England
The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are considered the "Big 6." This league's players compete at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.

La Liga - Spain
Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous for its highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively. Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic."

Bundesliga - Germany
Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat. While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and well organized strategies.

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, ①<u>established</u> in only 1992, it quickly ②<u>rose</u> to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are ③<u>considered</u> the "Big 6." This league's players ④<u>competes</u> at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ competes → compete. 주어가 players(복수)이므로 동사도 복수형이어야 함
det.analysis:
✅ ① established: 과거분사 분사구문 (EPL이 설립된)
✅ ② rose: rise의 과거형
✅ ③ considered: 수동태 are considered
❌ ④ competes: 주어 players는 복수 → compete가 올바름
det.tip: 주어-동사 수일치: 복수 주어(players) + 복수 동사(compete)

questions.passage: Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. This league is famous ①<u>for</u> its highly technical and creative players. The world's two most famous players both ②<u>played</u> in La Liga until 2021, ③<u>star</u> for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively. Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong ④<u>rivals</u> that their games are known worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ star → starring. 분사구문(동시 동작)이므로 현재분사 starring이 올바름
det.analysis:
✅ ① for: be famous for ~로 유명하다
✅ ② played: 과거 시제 (until 2021)
❌ ③ star: played와 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문이므로 starring이 올바름
✅ ④ rivals: 복수 명사 올바름
det.tip: 분사구문: 주절과 동시 동작 → 현재분사(-ing). played, starring for ~

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. ①<u>Founded</u> in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. The league is famous for a technique ②<u>calling</u> gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack ③<u>rather than</u> retreat. While FC Bayern München is considered the ④<u>strongest</u> team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② calling → called. '~라고 불리는 기술'이므로 수동(과거분사) called가 올바름
det.analysis:
✅ ① Founded: 과거분사 분사구문 (설립된)
❌ ② calling: technique은 '불리는' 대상이므로 수동 called 필요
✅ ③ rather than: ~보다는 — 비교 표현 올바름
✅ ④ strongest: 최상급 올바름
det.tip: called vs calling: 주어가 '불리는' 대상이면 called(수동), 주어가 '부르는' 행위자이면 calling(능동)

questions.passage: Barcelona and Real Madrid are ①<u>such</u> strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," ②<u>meaning</u> "the classic." While FC Bayern München is considered the strongest team, all 18 teams are known for their physical play styles and ③<u>well organizing</u> strategies. Like La Liga and EPL, each team ④<u>plays</u> all the other teams twice.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ well organizing → well organized. 'well + 과거분사'가 올바른 복합형용사
det.analysis:
✅ ① such: such + 형용사 + 명사 + that ~ 구문 올바름
✅ ② meaning: 분사구문(보충 설명)
❌ ③ well organizing: strategies를 수식하는 복합형용사 → well organized (과거분사)
✅ ④ plays: each team(단수) + 단수동사 올바름
det.tip: well + p.p.: well organized, well known, well established. 능동이 아닌 수동 의미이므로 과거분사

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of __________. Among the 20 teams, six are considered the "Big 6." This league's players compete at the highest level, play at a fast pace, and have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: importance(중요성) — 짧은 역사에도 중요한 위치로 올라갔다
det.analysis:
✅ ① importance: 빠르게 중요한 위치로 올라갔다는 맥락
❌ ② controversy: 논란은 맥락과 무관
❌ ③ isolation: 고립은 세계적 인기와 반대
❌ ④ decline: 쇠퇴는 빠르게 성장했다는 내용과 반대
det.tip: rise to a position of importance = 중요한 위치로 올라서다

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and ①<u>nearby</u> countries. The league is famous for a ②<u>method</u> called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they ③<u>swiftly</u> attack rather than retreat. All 18 teams are known for their ④<u>physical</u> play styles.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② method → technique. 원문에서 gegenpressing을 '기술(technique)'이라고 했지 '방법(method)'이라고 하지 않았으나, 이 문항에서는 technique 대신 method로 교체됨
det.analysis:
✅ ① nearby: 원문 그대로
❌ ② method: 원문은 technique. gegenpressing은 축구 '기술/전술'이지 단순 '방법'이 아님
✅ ③ swiftly: 원문 그대로
✅ ④ physical: 원문 그대로
det.tip: technique(기술, 전술) vs method(방법) — 축구에서는 technique이 자연스러움

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. Among the 20 teams, Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, and Tottenham are considered the "Big 6."
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"EPL은 1929년에 설립되었다."

det.korean: F — EPL은 1992년에 설립됨. 1929년은 La Liga의 설립 연도
det.analysis:
❌ T: 1992년이 맞음. 1929년은 La Liga
✅ F: EPL은 1992년에 설립됨
det.tip: EPL = 1992년 / La Liga = 1929년 / Bundesliga = 1963년

questions.passage: Spain's professional league, La Liga, was established in 1929 and has a total of 20 teams. Like the EPL, La Liga's teams play each other twice, for a total of 38 games each season. The world's two most famous players both played in La Liga until 2021, starring for Barcelona and Real Madrid respectively.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"La Liga의 팀들은 시즌당 총 38경기를 치른다."

det.korean: T — 20팀이 서로 2번씩 경기하여 총 38경기
det.analysis:
✅ T: 원문에 'for a total of 38 games each season' 명시
❌ F: 원문 내용과 일치함
det.tip: 20팀 × 2(홈/원정) = 38경기 (자기 자신 제외 19팀 × 2)

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용과 일치하면 T, 일치하지 않으면 F를 고르시오.

"분데스리가의 gegenpressing은 공을 잃었을 때 수비로 전환하는 기술이다."

det.korean: F — gegenpressing은 후퇴하지 않고 빠르게 공격하는 기술. 수비 전환이 아님
det.analysis:
❌ T: gegenpressing은 retreat이 아닌 attack
✅ F: 공을 잃으면 후퇴 대신 빠르게 공격하는 기술
det.tip: gegenpressing = 역압박. retreat(후퇴) 대신 swiftly attack(빠른 공격)

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: fast pace(빠른 속도) — EPL 선수들은 최고 수준에서 경쟁하며 빠른 페이스로 뛴다
det.analysis:
✅ ② fast pace: compete + play at a fast pace + highest skill이 병렬 나열
❌ ① slow tempo: 최고 수준 경쟁과 모순
❌ ③ low cost: 비용은 경기 스타일과 무관
❌ ④ great distance: 거리는 맥락과 무관
det.tip: pace = 속도, 페이스. at a fast pace = 빠른 속도로

questions.passage: Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic." Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams. The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing. This means that when a team loses control of the ball, they swiftly attack rather than retreat. All 18 teams are known for their __________ play styles and well organized strategies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: physical(신체적인) — 분데스리가 18팀은 신체적 플레이와 조직적 전략으로 유명
det.analysis:
✅ ③ physical: gegenpressing + 역압박 + 신체적 플레이가 분데스리가 특성
❌ ① artistic: 예술적은 La Liga(기술+창의) 특성
❌ ② defensive: 수비적은 gegenpressing(공격적 전환)과 맞지 않음
❌ ④ passive: 소극적은 빠른 역압박과 반대
det.tip: physical = 신체적인. Bundesliga는 physical + organized가 특징

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. While it has a relatively short history, established in only 1992, it quickly rose to a position of importance. questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ② EPL에는 20개의 팀이 있다 — 원문 일치
det.analysis:
✅ ② EPL에는 20개의 팀이 있다: 원문 'Among the 20 teams' 일치
❌ ① EPL은 영국에서 가장 오래된 리그이다: '가장 오래된'이 아닌 '비교적 짧은 역사'
❌ ③ EPL은 1929년에 설립되었다: 1992년에 설립됨
❌ ④ "Big 6"에는 8개 팀이 포함된다: 6개 팀
det.tip: EPL: 1992년 설립, 20팀, Big 6 = Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool, Man City, Man United, Tottenham

det.korean: ④ 분데스리가에는 20개의 팀이 있다 — 원문은 18팀

ch: La Liga는 기술적이고 창의적인 선수들로 유명하다.

questions.passage: ① Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. ② Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. ③ Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams once. ④ The league is famous for a technique called gegenpressing.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 원문과 다른 부분이 포함된 문장은?

det.korean: ③번 — 원문은 twice(2번)인데 once(1번)로 변조됨
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 그대로
✅ ② 원문 그대로
❌ ③ once → 원문은 twice. 각 팀이 다른 모든 팀과 두 번씩 경기

det.tip: EPL/La Liga/Bundesliga 모두 each team plays twice (홈/원정 각 1회)

questions.passage: The English Premier League, often called the EPL, is the highest professional soccer league in England. EPL 선수들은 모든 축구 리그 중 가장 높은 수준의 __________을(를) 가지고 있다.

det.korean: skill — EPL 선수들은 모든 리그 중 최고 수준의 기술을 보유
det.analysis: ✅ skill: 원문 'have the highest level of skill of all the soccer leagues'에서 직접 확인
det.tip: skill = 기술, 솜씨. EPL의 3대 특성: compete(경쟁), fast pace(빠른 속도), skill(기술)

questions.passage: Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, it includes a total of 18 teams from both Germany and nearby countries. questions.stem:

분데스리가는 공의 지배력을 잃으면 후퇴하지 않고 빠르게 __________하는 기술로 유명하다.

det.korean: attack — gegenpressing은 후퇴 대신 빠르게 공격하는 기술
det.analysis: ✅ attack: 원문 'they swiftly attack rather than retreat'에서 확인

questions.passage: Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic." Bundesliga is Germany's highest professional soccer league. Founded in 1963, __________. Like La Liga and EPL, each team plays all the other teams twice.

det.analysis:
✅ ③ 각 리그의 고유 특성: EPL=속도+기술, La Liga=기술+창의, Bundesliga=역압박+체력
❌ ① 모든 리그의 플레이 스타일은 동일하다: 각 리그마다 다른 특성
❌ ② 분데스리가가 가장 인기 있는 리그이다: 인기 비교 없음
❌ ④ EPL이 가장 오래된 축구 리그이다: EPL은 1992년으로 가장 최근
det.tip: 요약 = 글 전체의 핵심 내용을 포괄하는 문장

ch: 세계 주요 축구 리그들은 모두 같은 플레이 스타일을 추구한다.
분데스리가는 세계에서 가장 인기 있는 축구 리그이다.
세계 최고의 축구 리그들은 각각 고유한 플레이 스타일과 전술적 특성을 가진다.
EPL은 세계에서 가장 오래된 축구 리그이다.

questions.passage: Barcelona and Real Madrid are such strong __________ that their games are known worldwide as "el clasico," meaning "the classic." This legendary matchup has defined Spanish soccer for decades.
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

바르셀로나와 레알 마드리드는 매우 강한 __________이다.

det.korean: rivals — 바르셀로나와 레알 마드리드는 강한 경쟁자(라이벌)
det.analysis: ✅ rivals: 원문 'such strong rivals that their games are known worldwide'에서 확인
det.tip: rivals = 경쟁자, 라이벌. such strong rivals that ~ = 너무 강한 라이벌이어서 ~
